decision.conclusion: Accepted coverage materially affects residual silhouettes. Expanded selection improves this specific person case, and native Paint/EXIF8 can traverse the same strict RAW inverse. These observations justify coverage calibration and practical Mac inference work; they do not qualify PowerPaint or fixed native mask radii for release.
